landing.heroTitle:
PMP-standard project management,
not just a task list
landing.tagline: PMP-standard project management — with gamification and AI built in.
landing.heroDescription: From project charters, WBS, Kanban, Gantt, and risk tracking to gamification and an AI assistant — each organization is a fully isolated workspace.

model.title: Data structure
model.description: The whole app sits on a 3-layer hierarchy — every other feature is built around it.

project.label: Layer 2
project.title: Project
project.description: Its own key, charter, stakeholders, and document registry

task.label: Layer 3
task.title: Task
task.description: Parent/child WBS hierarchy, dependencies, Kanban, Gantt, linked risks

features.title: Everything a PM needs, in one place

wbs.title: Hierarchical tasks & dependencies
wbs.description: Unlimited-depth parent/child tasks, FS/SS/FF/SF dependencies with automatic cycle prevention.

kanban.title: Customizable drag-and-drop board
kanban.description: Default or custom columns, position saved instantly and preserved on reload.

gantt.title: Visual timeline
gantt.description: Every task on one shared timeline, based on real start/end dates.

risks.title: Risks & Issues
risks.description: Automatic severity score = probability × impact, sorted by priority.

ai.title: AI assistant
ai.description: Task summaries, subtask suggestions, natural-language task creation — always a suggestion you confirm.

charter.title: Project charter
charter.description: Purpose, objectives, scope, budget — approved separately; editing reverts it to draft.

stakeholders.title: Stakeholder register
stakeholders.description: A visual Power/Interest grid, supporting people outside the organization too.

documents.title: Document registry
documents.description: A catalog of project documents — category, version, status, link to where it lives.

gamification.title: Points & leaderboard
gamification.description: Activity points, streaks, 6 badges — encourages regular progress updates.

telegram.title: Telegram notifications
telegram.description: Assignment alerts and an 8am daily due-date reminder, via a shared Telegram bot.

artifacts.title: Self-authored HTML/CSS/JS pages
artifacts.description: Live preview in a safely sandboxed frame — like Claude's own Artifacts feature.

docs.title: Learn more
docs.description: Three documents generated by Claude, with diagrams and real screenshots from the app.

sotay.title: PMTool Handbook
sotay.description: A usage guide covering every feature in the order a new user would reach it.

kientruc.title: PMTool Architecture
kientruc.description: Business architecture, system architecture, tech stack, and data flow — with diagrams.

tongquan.title: PMTool Overview
tongquan.description: The data model, a feature map by phase, and links to the two documents above.
